messages:
Alex K: Quick update for Copperlane POC — need to lock milestones and owners. Proposed timeline: API contract freeze 2026-04-02, staging dry-run 2026-04-09, production cutover 2026-04-16. Can each owner ack?
Maya R: Ack for SE side. I’ll own API contract + test harness. :thumbsup:
Sean L: Eng infra — I can own staging infra and VPC peering. Need IPs from Copperlane by EOD Tue.
Raj P: Security — I’ll take certs/KMS + audit logging. Blocker: SAML metadata from Copperlane (they said they’d send today).
Emily S: Solutions eng — I’ll run the dry-run and UAT scripts. Need a code review merged for the client adapter, @Sean L can you review?
Sean L: Yep, pinged. Reviewing PR #4823 now.
Alex K: PR link: <https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/copperlane-adapter/pull/4823>
Emily S: Quick config snippet for the adapter env:
```yaml
COPPER_API_URL: https://api.copperlane-prod.internal
TIMEOUT_MS: 120000
CACHE_PREFIX: copperlane_poc
```
Alex K: Dependencies checklist: [x] Network lanes, [ ] SAML metadata, [ ] Certs, [ ] CR merged, [ ] Canary plan.
Raj P: I’ll follow up with Copperlane security contact today for the SAML metadata and push for the metadata endpoint.
deploy-bot: scheduled: staging-dryrun on 2026-04-09T14:00Z by Alex K — will run automated smoke tests.
Maya R: Success criteria for POC: 95% of inference requests < 250ms, embeddings quality (cosine > 0.92 on eval set), and zero unintended data egress.
Alex K: Added to the tracker. Any expected scope creep?
Sean L: Potential: large batch embedding payloads. We should cap batch size to 16 in staging and add an autoscaler rule for sustained qps > 200. I’ll add infra ticket.
Emily S: I’ll prepare the eval prompt set and ping QA to run the baseline comparison during the dry-run.
Maya R: I’ll own customer comms for the dry-run window and the post-run readout.
Alex K: Great. Next async check-in Friday 10:00 PT unless someone needs earlier. I’ll post a reminder in the channel.
Maya R: Thanks — tagging @Sean L again on the PR so we don’t miss the CR merge.
Sean L: Got it, aiming to merge by Wed EOD.
Emily S: If SAML metadata is still missing by Wed, we can run a smoke with a mocked SAML response to validate flow (won’t be customer-facing).
Raj P: Good fallback. I’ll confirm with Copperlane and update the checklist.
Alex K: :rocket: thanks everyone.
